verdict.rationale: Veo has a documented Gemini API that covers core text/image-to-video generation and multi-turn conversational editing through the Interactions API. A user also reports generating videos via paid GCP API usage. However, nothing documents parity with the UI surfaces (Gemini, Google Flow), and the API docs carry a deprecation/migration notice. Missing for 10: any documented statement of API–UI feature parity, evidence that Flow/Gemini UI features (camera controls, extended videos, audio) are all exposed via API, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
